cvEn:
Meir Hono-Cohen, son of Rahna and Efraim, was born on 21 Nisan 5686 (5 April 1926) in Iraq. He immigrated to the country in 1951. He worked mainly in agriculture and also as a carpenter. He was affiliated with HaPoel HaMizrachi. He was drafted into the IDF in April 1952.

He fell while performing his duty on 5 Adar I 5714 (8 February 1954) and was laid to rest in the civilian cemetery in Parvana (near Beit She'an). He left behind a pregnant wife and three children. On 23 Cheshvan 5729 (14 November 1968) he was reinterred in the military cemetery on Mount Herzl in Jerusalem.
